papers.title: Investigation on the interface of additively manufactured bimetallic structure: A molecular dynamics simulation
papers.abstract: In this study, • A molecular dynamics (MD) simulation analyzes Ti-Nb interfaces in wire-arc DED deposits. • Point defects at Ti-Nb interfaces are quantified under varying heat input. • Cluster counts drop in lower layers but rise in upper layers at high heat inputs. • Atomic size-mismatch-induced lattice distortion drives residual stress and loop formation. • Substrate and layers demonstrated compressive and tensile biaxial stresses, respectively. Multilayer depositions with varying interface behaviors affect the mechanical properties of deposited materials, so atomic-scale deposition mechanisms provide a better understanding of material behavior under multiple diffusion conditions. In this research, molecular dynamics is applied to investigate the behavior of the interface in Ti6Al4V-NbZr1 bimetallic structure deposited by wire-arc directed energy deposition (W-DED) in various heat input conditions. In addition, the interactions between the bimetallic structure and the distribution and size of dislocation loops are studied during deformation. It was found that the nano-melting pool forms before solidification, and the crystal growth proceeds by directional solidification, which can be equiaxed or columnar. Interdiffusion of the system shows asymmetrical diffusion behavior, and Nb atoms show a greater tendency to diffuse into the matrix in higher heat input conditions. According to the cluster analysis, the cluster number decreases from 76138 to 75720 for the first deposited layer, whereas it increases from 88046 to 90309 for the final deposited layer as heat input increases. Surface roughness decreases from 1.6 to 0.9 Å while the interface width increases from 30 to 50 Å as the heat input increases. It was concluded that atomic-size mismatch-induced lattice distortion enhances residual stress, resulting in dislocation loops. The formation of numerous 1/6 <112> Shockley and 1/2 <111> interstitial dislocation loops, along with a low amount of <100> and mixed loops, was also observed. At the substrate-interface, the biaxial stress is compressive, whereas the deposited layers exhibit tensile behavior.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是Ti-6Al-4V-NbZr1双金属结构的原子尺度界面行为，而非纯Ti-6Al-4V的力学或疲劳性能，因此与本方向关联度低。
llm.why_not_core: The paper investigates atomic-scale interface phenomena in a Ti-6Al-4V-NbZr1 bimetallic structure, not the mechanical or fatigue characterization of pure Ti-6Al-4V as required by this direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 理解Ti-6Al-4V-NbZr1双金属结构在原子尺度的界面行为
summary_zh.method: 采用分子动力学模拟研究不同热输入下界面缺陷与位错环
summary_zh.result: 发现了原子尺寸失配引起的晶格畸变导致残余应力和位错环形成

summary_en.motivation: To understand atomic-scale interface behavior in additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V-NbZr1 bimetallic structures.
summary_en.method: Molecular dynamics simulations were performed to investigate point defects, dislocation loops, and residual stress at the interface under varying heat inputs.
summary_en.result: Atomic size mismatch induced lattice distortion led to compressive biaxial stress at the substrate and tensile stress in deposited layers, with formation of Shockley and interstitial dislocation loops.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the study is purely computational.

papers.title: Computed tomography based investigation of critical defects and fatigue failure analysis of very high cycle fatigued Ti-6Al-4V produced by laser powder bed fusion
papers.abstract: This article aims to predict the crack-initiating defects and to estimate the fatigue limit of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V specimens with Murakami ’s empirical area -parameter model. For this purpose, fatigue specimens are manufactured by laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) using different process parameters and selected heat treatment methods. The specimens are scanned using xCT in two different manners: first full in reduced resolution to scan the complete geometry, and second the ROI in high resolution.. Afterwards, the specimens are tested cyclically in the very high cycle fatigue (VHCF) regime. Crack-initiating defects are analysed post-mortem using scanning electron microscopy (SEM). The defect population is examined in the xCT data, in which crack-initiating defects are identified. Using the empirical area -parameter model, the effect of defects on the potential fatigue location is determined. An outlook is given on the performance of the empirical area -parameter model on the prediction of crack-initiating defects and fatigue strength of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V specimens. • Lack-of-fusion defects dominate fatigue failure in LPBF Ti-6Al-4V. • El-Haddad fatigue-limit estimates are feasible but show high scatter due to defect size variability. • xCT can image large and small defects even when defect size approaches voxel size. • Low-contrast small defects appear in xCT but hinder precise quantitative analysis. • Defect morphology affects failure, requiring methods beyond the area -parameter model.

llm.relevance_to_user: 论文研究了热处理后LPBF Ti-6Al-4V的缺陷与超高周疲劳性能，但对后处理参数变化如何影响疲劳没有系统分析。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not systematically investigate how different post-processing treatments (e.g., heat treatment) modify fatigue performance; it focuses on defect prediction using Murakami's model with heat treatment as a secondary variable.

summary_zh.motivation: 基于xCT和Murakami模型预测LPBF Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳起裂缺陷和疲劳极限。
summary_zh.method: 不同工艺参数和热处理后，对试样进行xCT扫描和超高周疲劳测试，并用SEM分析断口。
summary_zh.result: 缺乏熔合缺陷主导疲劳失效，El-Haddad模型估算疲劳极限可行但分散性大，缺陷形貌影响失效。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验疲劳测试和断口SEM观察验证缺陷预测模型。

summary_en.motivation: To predict crack-initiating defects and estimate the fatigue limit of LPBF Ti-6Al-4V using Murakami's model combined with xCT imaging.
summary_en.method: Fatigue specimens were manufactured with varied process parameters and heat treatments, then scanned by xCT at two resolutions, followed by VHCF testing and post-mortem SEM analysis.
summary_en.result: Lack-of-fusion defects were the primary fatigue initiators; the El-Haddad approach gave feasible but scattered fatigue limit estimates, and defect morphology influenced failure beyond the area parameter.
summary_en.validation: Experimental VHCF tests and SEM fractography were used to validate the defect-based fatigue predictions.
